annotations.title: Food supplier certificate of analysis and audit certificate check: expired, mismatched, missing record fields, share by supplier and ingredient (signed)

description: Incoming supplier document check for food makers: send the certificates of analysis (CoA) and audit certificates you received, as fields your agent read from them (type; supplier and ingredient as your own labels; the supplier and ingredient names you expect and as printed on the document; lot received and lot on the CoA; issue, expiry, test, report and audit dates, results in_spec or out_of_spec, whether the lab and method are named). Get each document's issues (expired, expiring soon, supplier, ingredient or lot mismatch, out of spec, CoA record fields missing under 21 CFR 117.475(c)(8), audit dates missing, annual onsite audit overdue under 117.430(b)(1) when you set annual_audit) and the share found expired or mismatched by supplier and by ingredient, with the rule sections and dates read. check_sources true also asks the eCFR whether the four sections were amended since (20 an hour per caller). Signed record. Stores nothing; no model. Free: 120 calls an hour per caller. Docs: https://llpro.ai/supplier-document-exchange-for

as_of.description: Date to check on (default today, UTC).

check_sources.description: Also ask the eCFR whether the four rule sections were amended after the version we read.

annual_audit.description: Audit certificate only: true when your hazard analysis says this ingredient has a serious hazard the supplier controls and you have no written determination allowing less frequent audits (21 CFR 117.430(b)).

audit_on.description: Audit certificate only: the date (last day) the audit was conducted (YYYY-MM-DD).

expires_on.description: Expiry or valid-until date printed on the document (YYYY-MM-DD); for a CoA, a retest or best-before date if it gives one.

ingredient.description: Your label for the ingredient (a code or a name); used to group the shares, never compared with the document.

ingredient_name.description: The ingredient's name as on your order or specification; compared with ingredient_on_document.

ingredient_on_document.description: Ingredient or product as printed on the document (for an audit certificate: a product in its scope).

lab_named.description: CoA only: the laboratory that did the testing is identified.

lot_on_document.description: CoA only: lot printed on the CoA.

lot_received.description: CoA only: lot on the delivery you received.

method_named.description: CoA only: the tests and analytical methods are identified.

reported_on.description: CoA only: date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD).

results.description: CoA only: your comparison of its results with your specification.

supplier.description: Your label for the supplier (a code or a name); used to group the shares, never compared with the document.

supplier_name.description: The supplier's name as on your approved-supplier list; compared with supplier_on_document.

supplier_on_document.description: Supplier as printed on the document.

tested_on.description: CoA only: date the tests were done (YYYY-MM-DD).

warn_days.description: Flag documents expiring within this many days (default 30).
